lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately 10 visible longitudinal rows and 12 vertical columns across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows at approximately 90-degree angles, creating a repeating geometric lattice or grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal linear features on the upper third of the visible flank, showing a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) are attached to the body, specifically at the base of the first dorsal fin and along the mid-lateral and lower-posterior flank.
